significance: A 121-metre statue of Vishnu riding the divine bird Garuda, designed by the sculptor Nyoman Nuarta in 1990, begun in 1997 and completed in 2018 after a sixteen-year halt caused by the Asian financial crisis. It is the tallest statue in Indonesia and the tallest depiction of a Hindu deity anywhere.
story: The myth it renders has Garuda agree to carry Vishnu in exchange for the elixir with which he freed his enslaved mother.
